title: Audit actual Tensor expansion's signed internal contraction
body:
The physical Tensor proof states that its computed Gaussian expansion remains inside the chirp's input disk despite internal rounding. This independently audits that existing proposition at the actual `Tensor.run`/`LineApply`/`Tile`/`Block` caller. The proof derives all five signed truncation stages, the source A/K/B quadratic identity and final normalization, internal amplitude and work-width bounds, unique original-target ownership, and the complete halo/layout axis recurrence. It uses componentwise positive majorants and weighted Cauchy, without assuming rounding is linear.

The bounded signed p48/P80 fixture executes both actual expansion axes: 49 to 64 records, 64 Tiles, 128 Blocks and 3776 original truncations, including nonzero rounding at every stage and 320 retained overlaps. Every truncation and natural-coordinate output matches an independent exact integer model. Real negative-factor, target-order, zero-padding, original-axis, outward-rounding and ownership faults are rejected or distinguished. Borrowed ports remain intact and all scratch closes at the intentional pre-chirp stop.

Validation: CPython 3.12.2 normal/optimized and CPython 3.12.7 Git-free cold replay; registered normal replay and direct optimized replay, metadata/source pins, publication source-history preflight, official committed export integrity and Git-free cold replay. Exact finite evidence is frozen in `RESULT.json`; the quantified argument and full proved/inherited/unknown ledger are in `PROOF.md`.

This closes one conditional internal norm implication, not a complete physical supplier or Fourier theorem. Gaussian analytic/producer and exact word/convolution contracts remain inherited. Reduced-radius fixtures do not establish production tails; coefficient regeneration, complete chirp/compression consumers, production native setup/storage, CRT recovery and a new κ remain outside scope.

Canonical claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3664#discussioncomment-19140236

Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Retains the actual physical Tensor/expansion, Gaussian headroom and all nested source/archive contributors and notices.

Fresh overlap covers 309 open PR bodies, 4,156 Discussion records and all 6,760 local notes with complete reported pagination/inventory. New public deltas were checked; this remains advisory text coverage, excluding arbitrary diffs and unpublished work.
